sloka: सा तं जलाशयं सर्वं क्षोभयामास विस्मिता ।सहगैः पूर्वपुरुषैः स्त्रीभूतै रघुनन्दन ।। ७.८८.११ ॥
transliteration: sā taṁ jalāśayaṁ sarvaṁ kṣobhayāmāsa vismitā ।sahagaiḥ pūrvapuruṣaiḥ strībhūtai raghunandana ।। 7.88.11 ॥

translations.english: O delight of the Raghus, astonished, she agitated that entire body of water along with her companions, who were formerly men but had also become women.
